20.reason: The key 'cousins' rests entirely on reading 'she' in 'Mom said she'll be there at four' as Mom herself, so that the woman's aunt is the man's mother. The line equally supports a second reading where the man's mom is just passing on what the aunt said ('Mom said [your aunt]'ll be there'). Three options fit a plausible reading, and a listener who hears it once has no way to settle which person the pronoun means. The rest of the speech is natural.
